name: Rousměrov (Czechia, 2002–2018)
description: A blue field with a yellow triangle at the lower hoist and a yellow crescent-shaped device at the upper hoist.
history: The first flag of the municipality of Rousměrov, granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies on 14 March 2002 and replaced on 21 June 2018 by the flag with the cockerel of the municipal arms.
